script.problem: It has 39 words. A meaning is about 30 words at most.

terra.problem: A quiver is a case for arrows; it is not always full of them.

“It may mean his wife” is unclear. Clarke suggests that the quiver represents the wife, and that a full quiver pictures her having many children. The other notes picture the quiver as the home or family.
